items.title: 英国伦敦地铁司机开启冬季罢工
items.summary: 中新社伦敦11月26日电 (记者 欧阳开宇)当地时间11月26日，伦敦地铁司机正式启动今冬首轮24小时罢工行动。据悉，本次冬季罢工共计八日，分多时段开展，将持续至2027年2月，预计持续扰乱伦敦公共交通秩序，影响数百万通勤民众出行。
items.titleEn: London Underground drivers start a winter strike
items.summaryEn: London Metro drivers officially launched the first round of the 24-hour strike this winter. The eight-day, multi-stage winter strike, which is expected to last until February 2027, is expected to continue to disrupt London's public transport system, affecting the movement of millions of commuters.

items.title: 英国斥资80亿英镑提升核潜艇战备水平
items.summary: 中新社伦敦11月26日电 (记者 欧阳开宇)英国国防部26日宣布，已与本国企业巴布科克签署为期五年、总额80亿英镑的合作协议，用于升级英国海军核潜艇的维护保障体系，提升核潜艇战备水平。
items.titleEn: UK spends 8 billion pounds on improving nuclear submarine readiness
items.summaryEn: The UK Ministry of Defence announced on 26 November that it had signed a five-year, £8 billion partnership agreement with its parent company, Babcock, to upgrade the UK Navy's nuclear submarine maintenance safeguards system and improve its nuclear submarine readiness.

items.title: 世预赛惜败沙特男篮后，中国男篮容错率越来越小
items.summary: 中新网北京11月26日电(记者 刘星晨)在北京时间11月26日晚结束的国际篮联2027篮球世界杯预选赛第五窗口期比赛中，中国男篮最后时刻没能逆转比赛，以80:82负于沙特男篮。
items.titleEn: After losing to Saudi Arabia in the World Cup, China's men's basketball error rate is increasingly low
items.summaryEn: In the fifth window of the International Basketball Association 2027 World Cup qualifiers, which ended on November 26 in Beijing time, Chinese men's basketball failed to reverse the game at the last minute, losing to Saudi men by 80:82.

items.titleEn: Two Italian nationals killed in Iranian drone attack in Kuwait
items.summaryEn: A spokesman for the Kuwaiti military confirmed on 26 that two Italian nationals were wounded and killed in an Iranian drone attack on Kuwait that day.

items.title: 每秒要走近3米才能在绿灯内过完马路，残疾男子加速通行时被撞身亡……有温度的社会，要容得下等一等的时间！
items.summary: 34米马路仅12秒绿灯通行时间，成都一腿部残疾的男子过马路时走到一半红灯亮起，他加速通行，不幸被绿灯直行的摩托车撞倒身亡。
items.titleEn: Every second you have to get close to 3 meters to complete the road under the green light, and disabled men are hit and killed while accelerating through the road ... a warmer society, you have to wait until the next level!
items.summaryEn: A man with a disability in his leg walked across the road until half a red light came on, and he accelerated through, unfortunately being hit by a motorcycle driving under the green light.

items.title: 四大商业银行已与上市公司签订股票回购增持贷款合同超6000亿元
items.summary: 记者今天(26日)从工商银行等商业银行了解到，在中国人民银行近日会同金融监管总局、中国证监会等部门明确将股票回购增持再贷款政策由阶段性安排转为长期制度性安排，并进一步下调再贷款利率之后，工商银行、农业银行、中国银行、建设银行等多家银行迅速落实有关部署，加大股票回购增持贷款投放力度。目前，四大商业银行已签订上市公司股票回购增持贷款合同超6000亿元。
items.titleEn: Four major commercial banks have signed stock repurchase and loan agreements with publicly traded companies that exceed $600 billion
items.summaryEn: Reporters today (July 26) learned from commercial banks such as the Commercial Bank that in recent meetings of the People's Bank of China with the Central Bank of Financial Regulation, the Chinese Securities and Exchange Commission and other departments, it was clear that the repurchase and repurchase of shares and repurchases policy would be changed from a phased arrangement to a long-term institutional arrangement, and after further lowering the repurchasing rate, many banks such as Commercial Banks, Agricultural Banks, China Banks, Construction Banks and others quickly implemented the relevant deployments, increasing the repurchase rate of shares and increasing lending capacity. Currently, the four major commercial banks have signed stock repurchase and loan contracts for publicly traded companies worth over 600 billion yuan.

items.titleEn: The report says China's 3D printing industry is worth about 86 billion yuan this year.
items.summaryEn: The 2026 Additive Manufacturing Congress opened in Sichuan on 26 November, and the development report of the additive manufacturing industry in Sichuan released on 26 November showed that the size of the additives manufacturing industry is expected to reach about 86 billion yuan in 2026.

items.title: 北京获批医用手术机器人注册证数量居全国首位
items.summary: 中新网北京11月26日电 (记者 徐婧)医用手术机器人是创新药械的重要代表，也是北京高端医疗装备的优势赛道。北京市卫生健康委副主任陈航在26日举行的新闻发布会上介绍，目前北京已获批45个医用手术机器人注册证，数量居全国首位，覆盖骨科、神经外科、口腔、腹腔镜、介入等临床领域，并加快向眼科、心血管、放疗、儿科等专科拓展，形成多专科、全场景的产品矩阵。
items.titleEn: Beijing approves medical surgery robot registration number first in the country
items.summaryEn: China News Network Beijing, November 26 (Reporter Xue Xuan) Medical surgical robots are an important representative of innovative pharmaceutical equipment and a driving force in Beijing's high-end medical equipment. In a press conference held on the 26th, Chen Wei, deputy director of the Beijing Municipal Health Commission, said that Beijing has approved 45 medical surgical robot registration certificates, which are number one in the country, covering clinical fields such as osteology, neurosurgery, oral, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, intervention, and accelerated expansion into the fields of ophthalmology, cardiovascular, radiation, pediatrics, forming a multidisciplinary, full-scene product matrix.

items.title: 多人违规携无人机进京被查处 北京警方发布重要提示
items.summary: 自2026年11月15日新修订的《北京市无人驾驶航空器管理规定》(以下简称《规定》)正式实施以来，北京警方依法查处多起违规携带无人机及其核心部件进京案件。北京警方提示，广大市民群众和来京人员应提前了解相关规定，避免因不了解规定而遭受不必要的处罚和损失。
items.titleEn: Beijing police issue important tip for people with unmanned aerial vehicles in Beijing
items.summaryEn: Since the formal implementation of the newly revised Beijing City Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Management Regulations (BPD) on November 15, 2026, Beijing Police have prosecuted a number of cases involving unmanned aerial vehicles and their core components in Beijing. The Beijing Police advises that the general public and people in Beijing should be informed in advance of the relevant regulations to avoid unnecessary penalties and losses for not understanding the regulations.

items.title: 明起新一轮冷空气接踵而至 我国大部将迎大风降温
items.summary: 今天（12月14日），全国大部降水仍稀少，雨雪零散分布，冷空气影响也进入尾声阶段。不过，从明天开始，新一轮实力更强的冷空气接踵而至，将率先从新疆北部展开，随后逐渐给我国大部地区带来大风降温天气，同时西南、江汉等地降水也将增多。
items.titleEn: A new round of cold air is expected to bring much of our country to the brink of cooling.
items.summaryEn: Today (December 14), most of the country's rainfall is still scarce, rain and snow are scattered, and the effects of cold air are in the final stages. However, starting tomorrow, a new wave of stronger cold air will be delivered from northern Xinjiang, which will gradually bring cooler weather to much of China, while rainfall will increase in southwest, Jianghan and other areas.
